7
A train travels at a constant speed along a straight track.
Which statement about the resultant force on the train is correct?
A
It is bigger than the thrust of the engine.
B
It is constantly increasing.
C
It is equal to the thrust of the engine.
D
It is zero.

options.label: A
options.text: It is bigger than the thrust of the engine.

options.label: C
options.text: It is equal to the thrust of the engine.
